race.comment: CANADIAN FLING (11) was a smart winner fresh when resuming at the Gold Coast then can be completely forgiven for her last start as favourite when suffering heavy interference from a fallen horse, but she did hit the line strongly very late. With even luck this time, she'll prove hard to beat. SALCHOW (14) is the main danger after consecutive seconds at this track, the latest beaten a head. Peaking now and the inside draw gives him every chance to convert that consistency. KING EMPEROR (4) was beaten as favourite at Gold Coast but had won a CL1 at this venue the start prior and is two from two over the mile, so the return to this trip suits. NINJITZOU (12) brings honest Ipswich form, has a strong record at this track and looks ready to peak third-up. In the mix.
